title: 先把脚站好
description: 成人低位墙上先稳住高一点的大脚点，准备短距移手。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult brings one foot to a slightly higher broad foothold on a low slab while both hands remain comfortably placed. Capture the pause before the next hand move, with the pelvis gently above the new supporting foot and the other foot still low. The new step is modest, below normal knee height from the mat. A clean frontal diagonal view shows the sequence through a single stable posture, without arrows or ghost figures. Use risograph-inspired print design with limited coral and navy ink, grain within drawn forms, and intentional simplified silhouettes. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
